<!doctype html>
<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Ramp — Offline Portable</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#121629}
#app{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#121629}
#app[aria-busy="true"]{visibility:hidden}
#startupSkeleton{--sk-bg:#fbfcfd;--sk-card:rgba(255,255,255,.90);--sk-surface:#fff;--sk-surface-2:#f1f5fb;--sk-line:#d8e2f0;--sk-line-strong:#bcc8db;--sk-block:#f1f5fb;--sk-accent:#79a1fd;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2000;box-sizing:border-box;padding:22px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%,rgba(121,161,253,.18),transparent 30%),radial-gradient(circle at 95% 100%,rgba(147,167,208,.12),transparent 30%),var(--sk-bg);transition:opacity .15s ease;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:auto}
#startupSkeleton[data-theme="dark"]{--sk-bg:#121629;--sk-card:rgba(16,22,41,.88);--sk-surface:#161c36;--sk-surface-2:#1d2547;--sk-line:#2a3258;--sk-line-strong:#36406e;--sk-block:#1d2547;--sk-accent:#79a1fd;background:radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%,rgba(121,161,253,.18),transparent 30%),radial-gradient(circle at 95% 100%,rgba(147,167,208,.12),transparent 30%),var(--sk-bg)}
.sk-layout{max-width:1400px;margin:auto}.sk-header,.sk-tabs,.sk-card{border:1px solid var(--sk-line);background:var(--sk-card);border-radius:18px;padding:18px;box-sizing:border-box}.sk-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}.sk-tabs{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}.sk-tabs .sk-block{flex:1;height:36px}.sk-workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(340px,.75fr) minmax(0,1.65fr);gap:18px}.sk-block{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--sk-block);border-radius:8px;height:18px}.sk-block::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 20%,rgba(150,170,200,.16) 50%,transparent 80%);transform:translateX(-100%);animation:skShimmer 1s ease-in-out infinite}.sk-title{width:42%;height:22px}.sk-tools{width:100px;height:32px}.sk-field{margin-top:22px}.sk-label{width:38%;height:12px;margin-bottom:10px}.sk-input{height:44px}.sk-button{height:44px;margin-top:24px}.sk-result{height:120px;margin-top:20px}.sk-drawing{height:390px;margin-top:22px}.sk-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:18px}.sk-footer .sk-block{width:120px;height:20px}#startupSkeleton.is-leaving{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}@keyframes skShimmer{to{transform:translateX(100%)}}@media(max-width:760px){#startupSkeleton{padding:12px}.sk-workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sk-workspace>.sk-card:first-child{order:2}.sk-drawing{height:230px}.sk-tabs{padding:10px;gap:8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sk-block::after{animation:none}#startupSkeleton{transition:none}}
/* Match the real app shell proportions while the iframe is loading. */
#startupSkeleton{padding:0}
.sk-layout{width:min(1480px,calc(100% - 32px));max-width:1480px;padding:22px 0 28px;box-sizing:border-box}
.sk-header{min-height:68px;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:15px}
.sk-brand{width:210px;height:30px}.sk-header-tools{display:flex;gap:8px}.sk-header-tools .sk-block{width:40px;height:36px;border-radius:11px}
.sk-tabs{height:58px;padding:7px;margin:18px 0;gap:8px;border-radius:17px}.sk-tabs .sk-block{height:42px;border-radius:12px}
.sk-workspace{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.65fr) minmax(340px,.75fr);gap:18px;direction:ltr}
.sk-card{border-radius:18px}.sk-form{direction:rtl;padding:20px;min-height:650px}.sk-visual{direction:rtl;min-height:650px;padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.sk-card-head{height:75px;padding:20px 22px 16px;box-sizing:border-box;border-bottom:1px solid var(--sk-line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.sk-card-head .sk-title{width:170px;height:18px}.sk-card-head .sk-caption{width:220px;height:10px;margin-top:8px}.sk-view-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px}.sk-view-tabs .sk-block{width:52px;height:32px;border-radius:10px}
.sk-form-title{width:48%;height:20px}.sk-form-subtitle{width:78%;height:11px;margin-top:9px}.sk-form-section{margin-top:22px}.sk-form-section .sk-label{width:45%;height:12px;margin-bottom:8px}.sk-form-section .sk-input{height:43px;border-radius:10px}.sk-form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.sk-calc{height:44px;margin-top:22px;border-radius:11px}.sk-notice{height:14px;width:82%;margin-top:12px}.sk-result{height:164px;margin-top:18px;border-radius:16px}.sk-drawing{height:auto;min-height:420px;flex:1;margin:0;border-radius:0}.sk-drawing-tools{height:58px;border-top:1px solid var(--sk-line);padding:14px 20px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}.sk-drawing-tools .sk-block{width:90px;height:30px;border-radius:10px}.sk-footer{height:62px;margin-top:18px;padding:14px 18px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:15px}.sk-footer .sk-block{height:34px;width:100px;border-radius:11px}
@media(max-width:980px){.sk-workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sk-visual{min-height:580px}.sk-form{order:-1}}
@media(max-width:620px){.sk-layout{width:calc(100% - 18px);padding-top:9px}.sk-header{min-height:58px}.sk-tabs{height:54px;margin:10px 0}.sk-workspace{gap:10px}.sk-form{min-height:0;padding:15px}.sk-visual{min-height:580px}.sk-card-head{height:94px;align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;padding:16px}.sk-drawing{min-height:350px}.sk-footer{height:auto;min-height:90px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}}
/* Reuse the application's actual surface, border, radius, and shadow tokens. */
.sk-header,.sk-tabs,.sk-card,.sk-footer{background:var(--sk-card);border-color:var(--sk-line);box-shadow:0 20px 70px rgba(80,104,150,.12)}
.sk-header{border-radius:20px}.sk-tabs{border-radius:17px}.sk-card{border-radius:24px}.sk-footer{border-radius:15px}
.sk-block{background:var(--sk-block);border-radius:13px}.sk-card-head,.sk-drawing-tools{border-color:var(--sk-line)}
.sk-header-tools .sk-block,.sk-view-tabs .sk-block,.sk-drawing-tools .sk-block,.sk-footer .sk-block{background:var(--sk-surface);border:1px solid var(--sk-line)}
.sk-calc{background:var(--sk-accent);opacity:.65}.sk-input{background:var(--sk-surface);border:1px solid var(--sk-line)}
.sk-result{background:var(--sk-surface);border:1px solid var(--sk-line);box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden;padding:0}.sk-result-main{height:76px;padding:17px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between}.sk-result-label{width:92px;height:11px}.sk-result-value{width:138px;height:28px;background:var(--sk-surface-2)}.sk-result-details{border-top:1px solid var(--sk-line);padding:12px 17px;display:grid;gap:10px}.sk-result-details .sk-block{width:100%;height:12px;background:var(--sk-surface-2)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="startupSkeleton" role="status" aria-label="Loading Ramp Calculator">
  <div class="sk-layout" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="sk-header"><div class="sk-block sk-brand"></div><div class="sk-header-tools"><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div></div></div>
    <div class="sk-tabs"><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div></div>
    <div class="sk-workspace">
      <div class="sk-card sk-visual"><div class="sk-card-head"><div><div class="sk-block sk-title"></div><div class="sk-block sk-caption"></div></div><div class="sk-view-tabs"><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div></div></div><div class="sk-block sk-drawing"></div><div class="sk-drawing-tools"><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div></div></div>
      <div class="sk-card sk-form"><div class="sk-block sk-form-title"></div><div class="sk-block sk-form-subtitle"></div><div class="sk-form-section"><div class="sk-block sk-label"></div><div class="sk-block sk-input"></div></div><div class="sk-form-row"><div class="sk-form-section"><div class="sk-block sk-label"></div><div class="sk-block sk-input"></div></div><div class="sk-form-section"><div class="sk-block sk-label"></div><div class="sk-block sk-input"></div></div></div><div class="sk-block sk-calc"></div><div class="sk-block sk-notice"></div><div class="sk-result"><div class="sk-result-main"><div class="sk-block sk-result-label"></div><div class="sk-block sk-result-value"></div></div><div class="sk-result-details"><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div></div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sk-footer"><div class="sk-block"></div><div class="sk-block"></div></div>
  </div>
</div>
<iframe id="app" title="Ramp Calculator" aria-busy="true" tabindex="-1" inert></iframe>
<script>
(() => {
  const skeleton = document.getElementById('startupSkeleton');
  let theme;
  try { theme = localStorage.getItem('rampTheme'); } catch {}
  skeleton.dataset.theme = theme || (matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
  window.rampSkeletonPainted = new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve(performance.now()))));
})();
</script>

  const frame = document.getElementById("app");
  try {
